annotations.title: Investors: save a startup pitch to your PitchSpark saved pitches

description: For investors building a deal-flow shortlist: save one startup pitch (by pitch_id) to your PitchSpark saved pitches, to come back to on pitchspark.io. The founders are not contacted; the save counts as interest in their pitch statistics, where investors are numbered and never named. Saving again changes nothing. Returns status (watching, already_watching or limit_reached), pitch_id and next_steps. Needs a PitchSpark API key (psk_...) from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation), or where OAuth is enabled a token for one with the watchlist:write scope.

pitch_id.description: The "id" of a search or details result, copied exactly.

name: pitchspark_watch_pitch_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.
